content.raw:
This post uses the core blocks an importer meets most. A paragraph has bold, italic, an internal link, inline code, highlighted text, strikethrough and a line
break.

A level two heading

  • Second item, with a nested list
    • Nested one
    • Nested two
  1. Step one
  2. Step two

Content is the part of a site that outlives its theme.

A migration proverb
defmodule Hello do
  def world, do: "Hello <World> & friends"
end

    keeps   its spacing
and its line breaks.
